semantics.definition: From one stud's middle to the next, along x or along y: the one size of stud in the whole world. A bigger element carries more studs, not bigger ones, so a piece with sockets fits any element with studs, at any scale. Your word (23 Nov): "studs should have universally one single size", and the pitch of 0.3 m in your decision.
semantics.responsibility: Let every piece with sockets fit every element with studs.
